propositions: Empty verification outcomes (either raw-empty from provider or malformed-to-empty after reshape) must not produce valid pass or empty review results
Tolerant Pydantic parsing can normalize structurally divergent responses to empty results that should be treated as invalid verification outcomes
Decision layer already enforces indeterminate classification for any finding with no verification entry via pass3_decide's no-verification rule, covering both raw-empty and malformed-to-empty paths
Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) at the kernel-function level in verify_findings
Recoverable non-empty responses from supported provider/model variations must remain valid after normalization and repair
Pipeline-level telemetry wiring to emit outcome_counts from plan_review_decide and code_review_decide is tracked as separate follow-up work
